Amazon Clipper Premium Review

Review of Amazon Clipper Premium

RV Amazon Clipper Premium operates three different itineraries, cruising downstream along the Negro and Amazon Rivers. Cruise fares include guided shore excursions and activities such as canoeing and hiking in the Amazon Rainforest. Passengers board the vessel at the pier of Hotel Tropical Resort, located 10 km from Eduardo Gomes International Airport and 15 km from Manaus city center.

Guests are accommodated in spacious cabins furnished with either two side-by-side beds or one queen-size bed. All staterooms are equipped with air conditioning, a safety deposit box, and en-suite bathrooms with hot water. Onboard amenities include an air-conditioned buffet-style restaurant, a bar, a large meeting and lecture room with TV and DVD, and a full outdoor deck with hot tubs and showers for relaxation and refreshment.

The vessel’s shallow draft enables it to access remote areas of the Amazon that are unreachable by larger ships. Shore excursions utilize outboard-powered canoes for navigating narrow channels, lagoons, creeks, and flooded forests.

All meals are included and served in the onboard restaurant. Light meal options are available upon request. A variety of cocktails and beverages are offered at the bar.
